flow.name: axn-term - remote auth: device flow + JWT-bound /remote hello
flow.description: Reproduces the desktop remote-control auth path headlessly against the running axn-term-online scenario: the axn-term-desktop client must get a device_code from the device endpoint, a JWT must be mintable for the demo account, and /remote must deny anonymous hellos while accepting JWT-bound authority hellos (AllowAnonymous=false). Plain listeners: keycloak :18096, gateway :18095 (no TLS needed).

step.description: Device flow + JWT mint + /remote hello deny/accept

assert.description: all assertions in the step pass
